mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_info ( food_id, food_name, origin, current_owner, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{foodId}, #{foodName}, #{origin}, #{currentOwner}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE food_info SET current_owner = #{newOwner}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE food_id = #{foodId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, food_id, food_name, origin, current_owner, status, create_time, update_time FROM food_info WHERE food_id = #{foodId}
SELECT id, food_id, food_name, origin, current_owner, status, create_time, update_time FROM food_info ORDER BY create_time DESC
